description: Recommendation ITU-R P.1812-8 (September 2025, in force) gives a path-specific propagation prediction method for point-to-area terrestrial services from 30 MHz to 6 GHz. It predicts the signal level at the median of the multipath distribution exceeded for a given percentage of time (1 to 50 percent) and of locations (1 to 99 percent), using the terrain profile, for path lengths from 0.25 km to about 3 000 km with both terminals within about 3 km above ground. It is not suitable for air-ground or space-Earth circuits. Producer: ITU-R Study Group 3, in force in successive versions since 2007 (36-page PDF). Coverage: global. Access: the ITU page offers free PDF and Word files in four languages and a ZIP of components. Licence and cost: free to download; the cover page states ITU copyright with all rights reserved. Caveats: it is a specification, not software; the 2023 version's troposcatter term is flagged on the page as inaccurate at short distances, so users are advised to revert to the P.1812-6 term. Simulation uses: it turns terrain data into coverage and interference estimates for broadcast, mobile and fixed radio planning tools. Related records: the Python implementation py1812 (model-py1812), the less detailed P.1546 (model-itu-r-p-1546) and its implementation py1546 (model-py1546).
